script: tests/browser/library/library-tree.smoke.spec.ts, "records production Chromium timings for a near-limit library"
note: Production build (vite preview), Chromium via Playwright. search: typing a query that matches 238 rows of My library; clear: back to the collapsed tree, a full re-render from the catalog; expand: one top-level folder. allRootsOpen: the same with This project (the starter) and the Factory open as well, so four roots render and are searched. Three runs, every value 9-36 ms. Threshold for virtualization: 100 ms, so phase 7 skipped it. Phase 1's run (ba349a2, three roots): search 28-36 ms, clear 14-21, expand 14-19.
load: load averages 7.4 to 11 at the time
